deadline.value: GSNS runs four calls a year. The next one closes 1 Nov 2026 (for a 1 Feb 2027 start); for an Aug-Oct 2027 start, the 1 May 2027 call is the one to use.
deadline.quote: There are four PhD application deadlines each year, and the application system opens two months before each deadline. | For example, if you want to start in the period 1 August - 1 October, GSNS must receive your application no later than the May call (deadline 1 May).

gre_subject.value: The GSNS pages checked do not mention a subject GRE for this programme.

supervisor.value: The Mathematics programme strongly recommends contacting a potential supervisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: We strongly recommend that you contact a potential MATH supervisor to get support for your application.

also.quote: Before starting the application process, it is strongly recommended that you contact a prospective supervisor in order to discuss a potential project.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student has a complete financing plan, and personal or private funding is not accepted at GSNS.
funding.quote: If a student is admitted, it is the responsibility of Aarhus University to ensure that a complete financing plan is in place for the PhD student in connection with admission. | It is not possible to apply for a PhD programme at GSNS with funding through personal/private means.

entry_route.value: You may apply before you finish a master's degree, so a bachelor's holder can apply.
entry_route.quote: You are welcome to apply for a PhD position before you obtain your Master's degree.

notes: Mathematics programme at GSNS; its research areas include statistics and data science, so statistics is listed in also_fields. No separate datasci record was created.
